review.summary: The dark red background and overly urgent tone clash with Hale & Whitford’s traditional, professional brand, and the headline’s informal styling may be rejected. Adjust colors, tone, and hierarchy to meet the firm’s conservative expectations.

flags.issue: Background #5D1928 is a muted dark red that feels aggressive and likely conflicts with the firm’s established colour palette, reducing perceived professionalism and legibility of white text.
flags.suggestion: Replace the dark red with a more neutral, corporate hue (e.g., deep navy or charcoal) and ensure sufficient contrast for all copy.

flags.issue: Headline uses sentence case and an exclamation mark, creating an urgent, informal tone that a law firm typically avoids.
flags.suggestion: Rephrase to title case without exclamation, e.g., "Big Tax Changes Are Coming – Is Your Estate Plan Ready?"

flags.issue: Call‑to‑action button blends into the dark background and lacks visual hierarchy, making it easy to miss.
flags.suggestion: Give the button a contrasting colour (e.g., the firm’s accent colour) and add a subtle border or hover effect to increase prominence.

flags.issue: Drop shadow on the gavel adds unnecessary decorative depth for a professional legal brand.
flags.suggestion: Remove the shadow and keep the illustration flat to maintain a clean, authoritative look.
